description: What a vehicle cost over its last 12 months and since it was bought, by category (energy, tolls, maintenance, insurance, financing, tires, other), with the cost per kilometre and a completeness score. Amounts are in the vehicle's currency and are the cash spent: the purchase and the depreciation are not in them.

title: Vehicle costs

description: What is missing from a vehicle's records: odometer gaps and anomalies (the 20 most recent are listed), charges without a cost, unqualified drives, untracked distance, missing insurance or acquisition. "missing" ranks what to complete by what it is worth, the biggest first. Use it to say how far the costs can be trusted.

vehicle_id.description: the id of a vehicle, as returned by list_vehicles; its name is accepted when no other vehicle has the same

name: get_vehicle_data_gaps

acquisition_missing.description: true when the acquisition (purchase, loan or lease) is not entered or lacks details, so depreciation and financing are not fully known

acquisition_missing_fields.description: what the acquisition still lacks for the depreciation: purchase_price, resale_value and/or holding_period; empty when the acquisition itself is not entered

charges_without_cost.description: charging sessions recorded without a price, whose cost is left out of the totals

insurance_missing.description: true when no insurance premium is recorded and the lease does not include it

issues.description: the most recent gaps and anomalies, newest first, at most 20

at.description: RFC 3339 instant the problem was found

kind.description: ODOMETER_GAP (odometer moved with no drive recorded), ODOMETER_REGRESSION (odometer went down) or DISTANCE_MISMATCH (drive distance differs from the odometer)

missing.description: what to complete, ranked: the missing depreciation first, then the gaps with the largest estimated amount, then the ones that cannot be estimated

count.description: records behind the gap: charges or expenses; 0 when it does not apply

estimated_amount.description: rough cost left out of the totals, estimated from the vehicle's own prices; null when it cannot be estimated (the depreciation never is)

amount.description: decimal string such as 12.34, never rounded or converted, so do not turn it into a rounded figure

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the vehicle the amount belongs to

fix_in.description: where the owner completes it in the application: charges or expenses; null when it is the ownership details or the drives

kind.description: depreciation (resale value, holding period or price missing), unpriced_charges (charging sessions without a price), untracked_distance (distance no drive covers) or unconverted_expenses (foreign currency without a rate)

quantity.description: energy or distance without a cost, in quantity_unit; null when it does not apply

quantity_unit.description: kWh or km; null when there is no quantity

odometer_anomalies.description: number of odometer readings that go down or disagree with the drives

odometer_gaps.description: number of stretches of odometer that no recorded drive covers

score_dimensions.description: the weighted parts the completeness score is made of

applicable.description: false when there is nothing to evaluate for this vehicle; the part then carries no weight

score_pct.description: 0 to 100, how complete this part is

weight.description: weight of this part in the overall score

start_odometer_missing.description: true when the odometer at the start of ownership is not entered, so the distance before the first reading is not counted

truncated.description: true when more issues exist than the ones listed

unconverted_expenses.description: expenses in a foreign currency without a conversion rate, left out of the totals

unqualified_drives.description: drives not yet classed as professional or personal

untracked_distance.description: distance driven that no drive record covers, estimated from the odometer

vehicle_id.description: the vehicle these figures belong to

title: Vehicle data gaps

description: The trips of a vehicle, most recent first: when, from and to (the addresses the owner recorded, null when unknown), distance, duration, energy, and what tolls and parking cost. Filter with search (text in an address, to find a trip "to Lyon") and a period. Only the first trips are listed: matching says how many fit.

limit.description: how many trips to return, 20 by default and 50 at most

search.description: text to find in the departure or arrival address, for instance a city or a street

vehicle_id.description: the id of a vehicle, as returned by list_vehicles; its name is accepted when no other vehicle has the same

name: list_vehicle_trips

matching.description: how many trips fit the query, listed or not

trips.description: the trips that fit the query, most recent first

distance.description: distance of the trip; null when it was not recorded

energy_kwh.description: energy consumed in kWh; null when unknown

from.description: departure address as the owner wrote or looked it up, user text; null when unknown

tags.description: tags the owner put on the trip, user text

to.description: arrival address as the owner wrote or looked it up, user text; null when unknown

travel_expenses.description: cost of tolls, parking and ferries for this trip, null when none is recorded; a cost shared by a trip group is split between its drives by distance

amount.description: decimal string such as 12.34, never rounded or converted, so do not turn it into a rounded figure

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the vehicle the amount belongs to

truncated.description: true when more trips fit than the ones listed

vehicle_id.description: the vehicle these trips belong to

title: Vehicle trips

description: List the vehicles of the account: id, name, make, model, powertrain, currency and odometer. Start here to get a vehicle id.
name: list_vehicles

vehicles.description: the vehicles the account can see, its own and the ones shared with it

acquisition_type.description: CASH, LOAN, LOA (lease with a purchase option) or LLD (long-term lease); null when the acquisition is not entered

currency.description: currency of every amount of this vehicle, fixed at creation

id.description: identifier to pass as vehicle_id to the other tools

make.description: make, free text, empty when not given

model.description: model, free text, empty when not given

name.description: name the owner gave the vehicle, written by the user

owned_since.description: day the ownership or the contract started, YYYY-MM-DD; null when the acquisition is not entered

role.description: owner when the vehicle is the account's own, editor or viewer when it is shared with it

tracking_mode.description: connected (drives and charges synchronised from a telemetry source), semi_auto (pushed by an integration) or manual (entered by hand)

title: List vehicles
